notes.title: Patch note of 03/12/2016
notes.notes:
Hello !

Here's the details of this update :
 - You can now enable/disable Armageddon in the settings menu !
 - 2nd keyboard player now use the IJKL keys on both AZERTY and QWERTY layout instead of OKLM / OKL;. 
 - In some rare cases, the dwarfs can fall outside the golem between two rounds. This should be fixed with this update. Dont hesitate to contact us if you still have any problem of this kind.
 - The laser damage have been increased.
 - Some minor UI & text fixes.

Thanks for your support.
